description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Along with our partner, we are seeking a candidate who combines strong engineering skills with deep Salesforce administrator-level knowledge to deliver secure, performant, and upgrade-safe managed solutions deployed across multiple customer orgs.


Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce OEM & Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce OEM solutions using second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Build scalable, upgrade-safe features aligned with Salesforce OEM and ISV best practices
  • Implement application logic using Apex, SOQL, and SOSL, with careful consideration of platform constraints
  • Design solutions that efficiently operate within Salesforce governor limits, including limits related to CPU time, heap size, queries, DML, and concurrent execution
  • Develop modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Lightning framework
  • Ensure package versioning, dependency management, and release processes follow Salesforce standards


Platform Configuration & Administration

  • Apply deep Salesforce admin knowledge to design effective, maintainable configurations that complement custom code
  • Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered, screen flows, orchestration), ensuring automation is performant and governor-limit aware
  • Configure and manage profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, and sharing rules
  • Design and maintain page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and UI customizations
  • Evaluate and balance declarative vs. programmatic solutions to minimize technical debt and reduce risk of governor limit violations


Source Control & DevOps

  • Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows
  • Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (e.g., scratch orgs, packaging orgs, automated testing)
  • Support release management processes for managed packages across multiple versions and customers


Quality & Collaboration

  • Write comprehensive unit tests to ensure high code coverage and validate behavior under governor limit constraints
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex performance and limit-related issues across customer environments
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, and support teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions
  • Contribute to technical documentation and Salesforce OEM best practice guidelines


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience developing on the Salesforce Platform, particularly with hands-on experience with Salesforce OEM development.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs
  • Thorough understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits, including how they impact:

○Apex execution

○Flows and declarative automation

○Bulk processing and data volume

○Multi-tenant OEM applications

  • Deep Salesforce administrator-level expertise, including:

○Flow and declarative automation tooling

○Security and permissions modeling

○Page layouts and Lightning Record Pages

○Data modeling and configuration best practices

  • Experience using Git for source control in collaborative development environments
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data access patterns, and scalable design principles
  • Hold a Platform App Builder Certification is a valuable plus!


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build and scale advanced Salesforce OEM products that power multi-tenant enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineering & GenAI (GCP)
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.


Perfil valorizado: Quem já trabalhou com dados de negócio fora de grandes empresas de tecnologia — CPG, varejo, RH, mercado financeiro. A lógica de sell-in/sell-out, P&L e market share não é óbvia para todo mundo. Se você já navegou nesses contextos, vai se adaptar muito mais rápido.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

title: Enfermagem
description:
Quem somos


A Clínica Nuamse foi fundada em 2018 com o objetivo de atender um público que buscava excelência em estética, com atendimento exclusivo e personalizado.


Em 2023, a Dra. Cláudia Guimarães e o Dr. Fellipe Guimarães assumiram a gestão da clínica com uma nova visão: utilizar a medicina como ferramenta para melhorar a qualidade de vida dos pacientes por meio de um olhar humano, integrativo e centrado no bem-estar.


Após um processo de rebranding, a Nuamse passou a oferecer uma abordagem integral e personalizada à saúde, consolidando sua identidade como uma clínica de medicina integrativa de alto padrão.


A ampliação da proposta trouxe novos serviços voltados para:


  • Bem-estar
  • Longevidade
  • Performance e saúde preventiva


Hoje, a clínica conta com atendimentos especializados em:

  • Nutrologia
  • Nutrição
  • Dermatologia
  • Ginecologia
  • Endocrinologia
  • Pediatria


Com 6 anos de história, a Nuamse busca ser referência pela excelência no cuidado e por transformar a jornada de saúde de seus pacientes em uma experiência única e significativa.

Essa construção só foi possível com pessoas que também abraçaram esse propósito e contribuíram para a estrutura atual da clínica.


Este documento tem como objetivo esclarecer as principais funções e responsabilidades dos cargos da equipe, auxiliando no alinhamento das expectativas e no funcionamento eficiente da clínica.

Importante destacar que este descritivo não substitui os contratos firmados, servindo apenas como referência complementar para as atribuições de cada função.


Enfermeira de Clínica Médica


Descrição Geral

Profissional responsável pela assistência ao paciente, execução de procedimentos terapêuticos e suporte ao corpo clínico, garantindo a aplicação dos protocolos de qualidade e segurança na realização de triagens, exames e intervenções.


⏰ Carga horária: 20h semanais 

Salário: R$ 2.473,18


Principais Responsabilidades


Triagem, pré-atendimento e exames

  • Recepcionar pacientes e realizar triagem inicial.
  • Avaliar sinais vitais e medidas antropométricas.
  • Coletar informações relevantes de saúde, incluindo:
  • histórico clínico
  • hábitos de vida
  • medicamentos em uso
  • Realizar exames básicos como:
  • aferição de pressão arterial
  • glicemia capilar
  • bioimpedância
  • Registrar informações no prontuário eletrônico.
  • Orientar pacientes sobre os procedimentos a serem realizados.


Terapias Injetáveis e Infusões

  • Preparar e administrar medicamentos e terapias injetáveis conforme prescrição médica.
  • Garantir o correto manuseio e técnica de aplicação.
  • Monitorar pacientes durante e após os procedimentos.
  • Identificar e comunicar possíveis reações adversas ao médico responsável.


Apoio em Procedimentos Médicos

  • Preparar e organizar materiais e equipamentos necessários.
  • Garantir assepsia e condições adequadas durante os procedimentos.
  • Auxiliar médicos em:
  • implantes subcutâneos
  • curativos
  • procedimentos clínicos diversos
  • Preencher checklists operacionais e apoiar a organização de estoque e prontuários.


Organização e Controle

  • Controlar insumos e medicamentos da clínica.
  • Garantir armazenamento correto e reposição de materiais.
  • Organizar e higienizar materiais e equipamentos.
  • Manter o ambiente em conformidade com normas de biossegurança.
  • Supervisionar auxiliares e técnicos de enfermagem.
  • Acompanhar a qualidade dos procedimentos e prescrições.


Documentação e Registros

  • Registrar detalhadamente as atividades realizadas no prontuário do paciente.
  • Garantir preenchimento correto de registros e documentações.
  • Elaborar relatórios para a equipe médica e gestão da clínica.


Educação e Orientação

  • Orientar pacientes sobre cuidados pós-procedimento.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre tratamentos e procedimentos.
  • Participar de programas de educação continuada.
  • Colaborar com pesquisas e implementação de práticas baseadas em evidências.
  • Apoiar iniciativas educativas da clínica, como:
  • palestras
  • workshops
  • ações de saúde preventiva


Normas e Protocolos

  • Seguir protocolos internos e normas regulamentadoras da área da saúde.
  • Cumprir as RDCs da Anvisa aplicáveis.
  • Garantir proteção de dados conforme a LGPD.
  • Utilizar corretamente EPIs e práticas de biossegurança.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Graduação em Enfermagem com registro ativo no COREN.
  • Experiência


Experiência em atendimento clínico ou hospitalar, com prática em:

  • terapias injetáveis
  • suporte a procedimentos médicos

title: Senior Executive Assistant | Senior Virtual Assistant
description:
Saleslights | Full-Time | Remote (Brazil Only)


Salary: 3,700 BRL/ month


Saleslights is looking for a bright, enthusiastic, vibrant, and highly organized Senior Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant to work directly with ambitious founders and senior sales leaders in the United States.

The ideal candidate is already active on , enjoys building their own professional brand, and is interested in sales, marketing, technology, and social selling .


You may already be posting insights, engaging with business content, or participating in conversations around:

• B2B sales

• marketing strategy

• technology

• entrepreneurship


A background in sales and marketing is highly valued for this role.


Additionally, the ideal candidate is a passionate and skilled video editor who enjoys producing their own short-form social media videos and understands the dynamics of modern vertical video content.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with driven founders and elite sales professionals and thrives in a professional, fast-moving environment.


Overview:

Saleslights works with ambitious founders in the United States to help them build visibility, credibility, and authority through strategic communication and founder-led content.


Our clients are typically:

• cybersecurity founders

• B2B SaaS founders

• high-growth service company CEOs


They are visionary operators who move quickly and think strategically.

They do not need task managers.

They need someone who can manage communication, momentum, and execution around them.

Your role is to become the trusted operational partner for a small group of founders and senior / elite salespeople.


Your Mission:

You will manage up to three US founders or senior sales professionals and ensure they consistently complete a small number of high-impact activities each month.


Your job is to:

• organize communication

• keep projects moving

• motivate founder or sales leader participation

• maintain professional correspondence

• ensure key deliverables are completed


This role is closer to a Chief-of-Staff / Executive Assistant hybrid than a typical VA role.


Core Responsibilities:

You will manage the following for each founder or senior sales professional.


Founder Communication

Primary communication channel via email.


You will:

• write thoughtful, professional emails

• summarize discussions clearly

• guide founders or sales leaders toward next steps

• keep communication structured and calm

Expect to write long-form strategic emails , not quick chat replies.


Founder Momentum


Each month you will ensure founders or senior sales professionals complete:

• 2 short video recordings

• 5 document approvals

• up to 4 meetings


Your role is to:

• schedule

• follow up

• motivate

• remove friction

This requires strong soft leadership and persuasion skills .


Project Organization


You will maintain simple project tracking for each founder or sales leader.


Responsibilities include:

• organizing deliverables

• tracking approvals

• maintaining timelines

• ensuring no work stalls

You will operate similarly to a lightweight project manager .


Relationship Management


You will be the primary point of coordination between:

• the founder or sales leader

• the Saleslights internal team


You must maintain:

• professionalism

• calm communication

• clarity under pressure


What This Role Is Not

This is not a typical VA task role .

It is not:

• data entry

• admin errands

• simple task execution


This role requires someone comfortable working with driven founders, executives, and senior sales professionals from the US and Europe .

You must be comfortable with:

• fast-moving conversations

• high expectations

• strategic discussions


Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who has previously worked as:

• Executive Assistant to a CEO

• Chief of Staff style operator

• Agency Account Manager

• Founder or sales leader support operator


Key traits:

• extremely organized

• confident communicator

• calm under pressure

• professional writing ability

• proactive and responsible

You should enjoy working with high-performance personalities .


Work Structure

Each operator manages up to three founders or senior sales professionals .

Typical monthly workload per client:

• 2 videos coordinated

• 5 approvals managed

• 4 meetings maximum

This is a relationship and communication management role , not heavy operational labor.


Compensation


Salary: 3,700 BRL / month

Full-time role.

Because this is a high-trust position supporting founders and senior sales professionals directly:

outside client work is not permitted.


Why This Role Is Unique

You will work directly with founders and senior sales professionals building companies in:

• cybersecurity

• B2B technology

• high-growth services


You will gain exposure to:

• strategy discussions

• founder decision making

  • international business operations

O conteúdo com o qual a posição interage inclui imagens, vídeos e textos relacionados à vida cotidiana, mas também pode incluir (entre outros): bullying; discurso de ódio; segurança infantil; representações de danos a si mesmo e a outras pessoas; e maus-tratos a animais.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar inspeção de qualidade de diversos conjuntos de dados e projetos, garantindo que atendam aos requisitos do projeto e mantendo a entrega pontual dos casos de QA.
  • Demonstrar julgamento excepcional na resolução de casos ambíguos e fornecer feedbacks oportunos, identificando riscos potenciais e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Priorizar a qualidade, a segurança e a integridade do conteúdo, monitorar de perto o progresso do negócio e contribuir para iterações de otimização das funcionalidades do produto.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para otimizar políticas relevantes e procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs), apoiando processos de treinamento e esclarecimento para garantir entendimento preciso e entrega adequada dos dados.
  • Facilitar reuniões de calibração com as equipes envolvidas durante processos de apelação, analisar casos, oferecer soluções e sugestões para melhorar o desempenho, a precisão e o alinhamento da equipe com as metas do projeto.
  • Realizar a entrega de dados para métricas do projeto, fornecendo análise de dados, análise de causa raiz (RCA) e planos de ação durante reuniões de revisão de desempenho do projeto e revisões de negócio (WBRs, QBRs, etc.).
  • Assumir responsabilidades adicionais compatíveis e relacionadas conforme exigido pelo projeto, incluindo, mas não se limitando a: localização de políticas, suporte a treinamentos internos e externos, inspeção de dados, reuniões de calibração e avaliação de estratégias.


Qualificações

Requisitos mínimos

  • Proficiência em espanhol é obrigatória para colaborar com parceiros globais, incluindo equipes multifuncionais localizadas em regiões de língua espanhola. Essas interações incluem liderar e participar de reuniões conduzidas em espanhol, bem como comunicação por chat ou e-mail.
  • Conhecimento sobre mecanismos de busca e familiaridade com plataformas de redes sociais.
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em projetos fora da área principal de especialização quando necessário e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos variáveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e madrugadas, garantindo disponibilidade em cinco de cada sete dias da semana.
  • Disposição para trabalhar com conteúdos sensíveis e potencialmente perturbadores.


Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência em QA, moderação, anotação de IA ou equivalente, conhecimento de mercado, entendimento da cultura local e dos hábitos de uso da internet dos mercados-alvo.
  • Familiaridade com negócios relacionados a compras online e tendências de busca é desejável.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, incluindo análise de dados, capacidade de aprendizado, resolução de problemas, adaptabilidade e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proficiência em softwares comuns de produtividade (ex.: Office Suite, Google Workspace, etc.).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz com equipes multifuncionais e stakeholders em diferentes localidades e fusos horários.

This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.

title: Pessoa engenheira de gestão de ativos
description:
No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.
No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.
Missão do Cargo
Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.
Assegurar a disponibilidade operacional, o cumprimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias, e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem preventiva
e sustentável.
Responsabilidades Principais
Executar e apoiar tecnicamente as inspeções e avaliações de integridade dos equipamentos e dutos, realizando acompanhamento de campo, controle de relatórios e registros
técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis
Acompanhar a execução de reparos e adequações identificadas nas inspeções, verificando a conformidade técnica das intervenções com os códigos de projeto, normas
regulamentadoras e especificações internas.
Realizar análises técnicas de falhas e contribuir em estudos de melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias como RCA, FMEA e RCM, e propondo soluções técnicas que reforcem
a confiabilidade dos ativos
Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos e instruções de trabalho, assegurando alinhamento com os padrões corporativos e oferecendo suporte técnico ao time de manutenção
e inspeção.
Monitorar a condição e a funcionalidade dos dispositivos de proteção mecânica, como válvulas de alívio e sistemas contra sobrepressão, realizando inspeções técnicas e
mantendo atualizada a documentação correspondente.
Dar suporte técnico à gestão de mudanças e à resposta a emergências, participando do desenvolvimento de Mo Cs e colaborando em investigações de falhas e incidentes
envolvendo sistemas pressurizados.
Disseminar boas práticas de confiabilidade e apoiar auditorias técnicas, contribuindo para a formação técnica das equipes, participando de comitês quando solicitado e
promovendo a padronização dos processos de engenharia.
Coletar, analisar e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade e integridade, colaborando com a área corporativa no desenvolvimento de KPIs e estudos estatísticos que
embasem a tomada de decisão técnica.
Requisitos
Formação: Ensino Superior Completo;
Áreas de formação: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica e Materiais;
Desejável: Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA);
Disponibilidade para contrato temporário de 9 meses;
Experiência Técnica: Metodologias de Confiabilidade (RCA, FMEA, RCM), Inspeção e Integridade de Equipamentos Estáticos e Dinâmicos, Gestão de Indicadores e Análise de Dados Técnicos e Elaboração de Procedimentos Técnicos e Apoio a Mo Cs;
Certificações: CREA
Idiomas: Inglês Básico/Avançado;
Soft skills: Engajamento, protagonismo, foco em resultado, iniciativa e assertividade.
Hard skills: Conhecimento/Experiência com NR 13 e Experiência com Inspeção de Caldeiras e vasos de pressão.
Local de Trabalho
Camaçari- BA - Brasil
A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Coordenador de arquitetura de dados
description:
Sobre a área:A área de Arquitetura de Dados é responsável por definir, estruturar e sustentar as bases tecnológicas que permitem a coleta, o processamento, a integração e o consumo de dados de forma segura, escalável e alinhada às estratégias do negócio. Atua na definição de padrões, políticas e modelos arquiteturais, garantindo a qualidade, governança e disponibilidade das informações para apoiar análises, produtos de dados e a tomada de decisão em toda a organização.Além do aspecto técnico, a área trabalha de forma colaborativa com times de TI, Analytics e áreas de negócio, antecipando necessidades, avaliando tecnologias emergentes e propondo soluções inovadoras. Seu papel é viabilizar uma arquitetura robusta e sustentável, que suporte o crescimento da empresa, promova eficiência operacional e fortaleça a cultura orientada a dados.Principais atividades:Coordenar atividades operacionais do time de Arquitetura e Plataforma de Dados.
Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de arquiteturas de dados alinhadas aos objetivos
organizacionais.
Participação em processos de recrutamento e desenvolvimento de talentos e desligamento de
profissionais.
Fomentar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo
e desenvolvimento de habilidades.
Interagir com líderes de outras áreas para entender suas necessidades analíticas.
Participação na gestão de orçamentos e recursos.
Relatar os resultados para a gerência e recomendar melhorias.
Tomar decisões relacionadas à arquitetura de dados
Estabelecer e fazer cumprir padrões e políticas relacionadas ao uso de dados.
Definir estratégias de Gestão e moldar a direção técnica.
Resolver desafios complexos e inovadores.
Estabelecer parcerias estratégicas.
Fomentar a disseminação de uma cultura organizacional que valorize a utilização eficaz de dados na
tomada de decisões.
Acompanhamento de tendências em engenharia de dados e aplicação de tecnologias emergentes
Colaboração com equipes de TI e outras áreas
Participação na gestão de contratos com fornecedores
Participação nos processos de definição de novos cargos ou novas expertises necessárias às funções
do setor
Acompanhamento de registros de ponto; alinhamento das férias, folgas remuneradas e banco de
horas
Verificação e orientação sobre atestados médicos e licenças e participação em iniciativas de saúde e
suporte ao bem-estar
Contribuição para políticas de remuneração, benefícios, reconhecimento, incentivos, feedback e
mentorias
Participação no desenvolvimento de planos de carreira, treinamento e desenvolvimento individual
Abertura, acompanhamento e finalização de chamados de TIBuscamos alguém que apresente:Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática,
Engenharia ou área correlata.
Inglês intermediário (desejável avançado para leitura)
Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Project)
Experiência com gestão de pessoas.
Experiência em liderança para recrutar, delegar e motivar um time de profissionais de dados.
Experiência em desenvolvimento de talentos e gestão de desempenho.
Experiência em gestão de orçamento para alocar recursos de maneira eficiente.
Visão estratégica de negócios e do time de dados.
Experiência em gestão de projetos de dadosConhecimentos Técnicos:Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C): Expertise em ferramentas de Ia C como Terraform, Pulumi e
Cloud Formation.
Plataformas de Dados: Expertise em Databricks, incluindo gerenciamento e otimização de clusters.
Computação em Nuvem: Experiência avançada com AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda,
RDS, EMR, Glue, Athena e Sage Maker. Conhecimento em GCP e Azure é um diferencial.
Ferramentas de CDC: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CDC, entendo os tradeoffs entre as
diferentes ferramentas e quando faz sentido usar cada.
Armazenamento e Arquitetura de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em arquiteturas de data
lakehouse, incluindo Delta Lake e a estrutura Medallion.
Deploy de Modelos de Machine Learning: Experiência avançada no deploy e monitoramento de
modelos de machine learning.
Ferramentas de ETL e Orquestração: Expertise com Apache Airflow, dbt, e outras ferramentas de ETL.
Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência avançada em Python e SQL.
Boas Práticas de Engenharia de Software: Aplicação de princípios de engenharia de software, como
controle de versão, testes automatizados, integração contínua e deploy contínuo (CI/CD).
Governança de Dados: Expertise em políticas de governança de dados, incluindo a gestão de dados
sensíveis e privados, conformidade com regulamentos (ex: LGPD), e uso de catálogos de dados para
garantir a acessibilidade e qualidade dos dados.Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Informações da vaga:
Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
Carga Horária: 220h
Escala: Segunda a sexta
Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar:
• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
• Acesso à plataforma Oriente Me para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.Proteção e estabilidade:
• Previdência privada;
• Participação nos lucros;
• Seguro de vida.Facilidades para o dia a dia:
• Vale-Alimentação;
• Vale-Refeição;
• Vale-Transporte;
• Auxílio-Creche;
• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.Desenvolvimento e educação:
• Plataforma de ensino;
• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:

title: It service desk - advanced english
description:
What a day in the life looks like:
Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.
Maintain accurate, detailed documentation within the ticketing system.
Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.What you bring to the team:
BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
3 years of technical customer support experience.
Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
Familiarity with Service Now or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
Fluency in English. MandatoryYou Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience WithSupply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in Red Prairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)Why join us?
At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better.

title: Bilingual civil engineer (load analysis: structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company
Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.
Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, Sys Pro, D365 & Salesforce.
One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / Gen AI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.We are seeking a multipleCivil Engineerswith emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.
English language proficiency is mandatory.These are remote roles.This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.ROLES:
1) Civil Engineers(3+ years of experience)
2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE(0-3 years of experience)Executive Summary
Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.Primary Duties
Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leadsExperience level
Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

Cloud Formation.

RDS, EMR, Glue, Athena e Sage Maker. Conhecimento em GCP e Azure é um diferencial.
